generations.name: Neue Klasse
generations.notes: Sloped-roof sibling of the Neue Klasse iX3 with the same hardware: Gen6, 800 V, 108.7 kWh net (Europe; about 112 kWh quoted for the US), up to 400 kW DC; US arrival March 2027. Kept as its own model because BMW sells it and EPA rates it under its own base model "iX4". Confidence: medium (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Sources: https://www.press.bmwgroup.com/usa/article/detail/T0461507EN_US/the-bmw-ix4 ; https://www.bmwblog.com/2026/10/07/2027-bmw-ix4-debut-specs-photos/
